scope: The finite M3.0-M3.6 engineering roadmap authorized for this project; not full upstream framework deployment or exhaustive data/alpha discovery.

requirements.requirement: Common hypothesis/source adapters and real reject/survivor evaluation with immutable lineage
Real budgeted model generation, imports, validation and retained failures
Real three-round research feedback and frozen once-budgeted model stage
Evaluated parent-linked crossover children, negative memory and no-repeat restart
Pinned native AlphaForge/AlphaSAGE generation, export replay and common screening
Two real advisory opposing reviews with checked citations, read-only research stores and restart
Shared daily/PIT contract, exact panel transfer and actual PIT candidate screening
Unified CLI, runtime lifecycle, recovery, documentation and required regression

limitations: All adaptive statistics are historical exploration; no campaign-wide confirmatory claim.
2021-2025 qualification/lockbox remain sealed and trading is not authorized.
Native external search runs are bounded interface acceptance, not full paper performance reproduction.
Six PIT fields retain vendor revision uncertainty, missing/stale values and possible differing fiscal periods.
Financial-input survivor model branch was not exercised by the rejected PIT pilot; shared input binding is covered by tests.
Two roles use the same local model and produced mostly summaries; deep mechanism criticism and prose factual accuracy are not guaranteed.
Bootstrap/q reused by independent verification, not independently resampled; no fill-level execution or capacity proof.
Event/text/microstructure data and full financial vintages require separately defined adapters and availability contracts.
